City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
la puente City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
OCTOBER 22, 2013
7:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Klinakis, Lewis Argudo, Holloway, and House
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS - None.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS - None.
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF OCTOBER 8, 2013
Staff Recommends: It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular meeting of October 8, 2013.
10-08-2013 CC-SA Minutes
RECESS THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/ Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTERS NOS. 1351
Action Taken : The City Council/Successor Agency adopted Resolution No. 13-5000 approving Warrant Registers Nos. 1351
WR# 1351
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF FIRST QUARTER FISCAL YEAR 2013-2014 FINANCIAL REVIEW
Action Taken : The City Council received and filed this report.
D-2 Staff Report on First Quarter FY 13-14 General Fund Financial Review
D-2 Attach A - Revenue & Expense Report =- Sept 30
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF FIRST QUARTER INVESTMENT REPORT
Action Taken : The City Council received and filed the report.
D-3 Staff Report on First Quarter Investment Report
D-3 Attach A- LAIF Rates
D-3 Attach B- LAIF Statement Sept 2013
D-3 Attach C- Union Bank Sept 2013
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING A REQUEST FOR A FEE WAIVER OF BUSINESS LICENSE FEE, INSURANCE FEE, CARNIVAL OPERATOR BUSINESS LICENSE FEE, AND CARNIVAL OPERATOR PERMIT FEE FOR THE OLD TOWN PUENTE ASSOCIATION'S ANNUAL HOLIDAY STREET FAIR
Staff Recommends: It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution approving a request for a fee waiver for the Old Town Puente Association's 2013 Holiday Street Fair.
E-1 Staff Report Fee Waiver Old Town Puente Association
E-1 Attach A - Resolution Fee Waiver Old Town Puente Association
E-2
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION ON THE CITY'S HOLIDAY HOME DECORATION CONTEST
Action Taken : The City Council discussed and provided direction.
E-2 Staff Report Direction Regarding the Holiday Home Decorating Contest
E-3
AMENDMENTS TO THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE CONCERNING NON-COMMERCIAL SIGNS
Staff Recommends: It is recommended that the City Council direct the Planning Commission to hold a public hearing to consider amendments to Municipal Code concerning non-commercial signs.
E-3 Staff Report Non Commercial Signs 101713
E-3 Attach A - Section 10.74.060
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 98-3908, AND ESTABLISHING COST RECOVERY FOR DUPLICATION OF CERTAIN RECORDS PURSUANT TO THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC RECORDS ACT
Staff Recommends: It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolution, amending Resolution No. 98-3908, and authorizing the City to recoup its costs when an outside vendor is used to duplicate records, and any additional costs incurred by the City for the reproduction of electronic records. It is also recommended that the City receive payment for the duplication of these types of records prior to the work being performed by an outside vendor or City staff.
E-4 Staff Report PRA Photocopying Fee
E-4 Attach A - Resolution PRA Photocopying Fee
RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION
F.
CLOSED SESSION
F-1
THE CITY COUNCIL WILL RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54957, PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT - CITY MANAGER
RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION
REPORT OUT OF CLOSED SESSION
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS - None.
AB 1234 REPORTS - None.
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection at the City Clerk Department at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street and the Reference Desk at the Library located at 15920 E. Central during normal business hours. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements.
Dated this 17th day of October, 2013.
Pat Jacquez-Nares, CMC, City Clerk
Official 10-22-13 CC-SA Minutes Reg - Signed

City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
MINUTES
LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY REGULAR MEETINGS
REGULAR MEETING OF
October 22, 2013
A Regular Meeting of the City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings of the City of La Puente was held in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 15900 East Main Street, La Puente, California, on October 22, 2013, at 7:00 p.m.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS - None.
Vince House moved to add the Closed Session to the agenda for Council consideration; seconded by David Argudo.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Dan Holloway, Charlie Klinakis, David Argudo, Vince House, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: None.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS - None.
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF OCTOBER 8, 2013
10-08-2013 CC-SA Minutes
David Argudo moved to waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the Regular meeting of October 8, 2013 ; seconded by Dan Holloway.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Dan Holloway, Charlie Klinakis, David Argudo, Vince House, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: None.
RECESS THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - None.
D.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
Action Taken : All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/ Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
David Argudo moved to Consent Calendar Item Nos. D-1 through D-3; seconded by Vince House.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Dan Holloway, Charlie Klinakis, David Argudo, Vince House, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: None.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTERS NOS. 1351
WR# 1351
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF FIRST QUARTER FISCAL YEAR 2013-2014 FINANCIAL REVIEW
D-2 Staff Report on First Quarter FY 13-14 General Fund Financial Review
D-2 Attach A - Revenue & Expense Report =- Sept 30
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF FIRST QUARTER INVESTMENT REPORT
D-3 Staff Report on First Quarter Investment Report
D-3 Attach A- LAIF Rates
D-3 Attach B- LAIF Statement Sept 2013
D-3 Attach C- Union Bank Sept 2013
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING A REQUEST FOR A FEE WAIVER OF BUSINESS LICENSE FEE, INSURANCE FEE, CARNIVAL OPERATOR BUSINESS LICENSE FEE, AND CARNIVAL OPERATOR PERMIT FEE FOR THE OLD TOWN PUENTE ASSOCIATION'S ANNUAL HOLIDAY STREET FAIR
E-1 Staff Report Fee Waiver Old Town Puente Association
E-1 Attach A - Resolution Fee Waiver Old Town Puente Association
Charlie Klinakis moved to adopt Resolution No. 13-5100 approving a request for a fee waiver for the Old Town Puente Association's 2013 Holiday Street Fair; seconded by David Argudo.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Dan Holloway, Charlie Klinakis, David Argudo, Vince House, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: None.
E-2
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION ON THE CITY'S HOLIDAY HOME DECORATION CONTEST
E-2 Staff Report Direction Regarding the Holiday Home Decorating Contest
Vince House moved to accept the recommendations and to have the Puente Pride Committee be the sole judges.; seconded by Dan Holloway.
The motion unanimously carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Dan Holloway, Charlie Klinakis, David Argudo, Vince House, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: None.
E-3
AMENDMENTS TO THE CITY'S MUNICIPAL CODE CONCERNING NON-COMMERCIAL SIGNS
E-3 Staff Report Non Commercial Signs 101713
E-3 Attach A - Section 10.74.060
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION AMENDING RESOLUTION NO. 98-3908, AND ESTABLISHING COST RECOVERY FOR DUPLICATION OF CERTAIN RECORDS PURSUANT TO THE CALIFORNIA PUBLIC RECORDS ACT
E-4 Staff Report PRA Photocopying Fee
E-4 Attach A - Resolution PRA Photocopying Fee
Vince House moved to adopt Resolution No. 13-5002, amending Resolution No. 98-3908, and authorizing the City to recoup its costs when an outside vendor is used to duplicate records, and any additional costs incurred by the City for the reproduction of electronic records. It is also recommended that the City receive payment for the duplication of these types of records prior to the work being performed by an outside vendor or City staff; seconded by Violeta Lewis.
The motion carried by the following roll call vote: AYES: Dan Holloway, Charlie Klinakis, Vince House, and Violeta Lewis. NOES: David Argudo.
RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION

Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
